name: harness5
description: harness5 ships the cda-plugins workflow skills and a local infrastructure stack (OpenTelemetry collector, SigNoz) as a self-contained plugin for Claude Code and Codex, living under plugins/harness5/ in a multi-plugin distribution repo.

interface.shortDescription: cda-plugins workflow skills and local infra stack (OTel, SigNoz) for Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: harness5 is the cda-plugins workflow-skills and infrastructure plugin, packaged self-contained under plugins/harness5/. The same skills/ and infrastructure/ tree ships to both Claude Code and Codex. After a fresh install, run the harness5-init skill to scaffold infrastructure/.env from .env.example and bring the docker compose stack (OpenTelemetry collector, SigNoz) up as a shared local instance.
